body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> DisplayLink congratulates Samsung for being named an honoree in the 2009 CES Innovations Design and Engineering Awards in the Computer Peripherals category for the 'SyncMaster D190SX' Sidekick Display' featuring DisplayLink's USB graphics hardware and software.

Integrated with DisplayLink's USB graphic technology, the SyncMaster D190SX enables netbook and notebook users alike to expand their workspace and their productivity by simply and easily connecting to the Samsung display via a USB connection.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
